video_caption: The video begins with a man, sporting short dark hair, a beard, and glasses, wearing a grey t-shirt, sitting in front of a large, curved aquarium filled with lush green aquatic plants and small fish. He makes a thumbs-up gesture at the start, then uses various hand gestures, including open palms and precise finger movements, as he speaks directly to the camera with a serious but animated expression. Behind him and to his sides are wooden bookshelves packed with books, and the wall is painted orange. At 0:18, the scene transitions to a plain gradient grey background, and the text "NickMach007" appears on the left. This is followed by "The Planted Tank" appearing below it at 0:21. From 0:23 to 0:25, a stylized black line drawing resembling a plant stem or vine grows from the bottom center, intertwining to form the words "Nick Mach 007 The Planted Tank" around its upper curves. Simultaneously, at 0:26, a black silhouette of a hammerhead shark swims from the right to the left across the bottom of the screen. At 0:29, the video cuts back to the man in his original setting, continuing to speak with hand gestures.

A man with short dark hair, a beard, and glasses is seated in a dark wooden chair, wearing a light blue-grey Henley shirt. He speaks directly to the camera, using a variety of hand gestures for emphasis. His right hand is initially open and extended, palm up, in an explanatory gesture. He then brings his hands together before making small "pinching" gestures with his right thumb and forefinger several times throughout the clip to emphasize points. His facial expression is engaged and focused. Behind him, a large, curved glass aquarium is filled with lush green aquatic plants, small fish, and a dark substrate. Flanking the aquarium on both sides are tall wooden bookshelves packed with books. The wall behind him and the shelves is a vibrant orange color. The scene remains static throughout the segment.

A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a grey polo shirt, is seated in a chair, gesturing with his hands in front of a brightly lit aquarium filled with green aquatic plants and small fish. Behind and to the sides of him are bookshelves packed with books. From 00:04 to 00:11, the word "GLUTARALDEHYDE" appears in white, stylized text on the aquarium glass. Around 00:07, a small, rectangular image of a basketball player in a red "ROCKETS 55" jersey briefly appears over the man's left shoulder, partially obscuring his face, before disappearing.

A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a grey collared shirt, sits and speaks while gesturing with his hands in front of a large, curved aquarium filled with lush green aquatic plants and several small fish. To his left and right are tall wooden bookshelves stocked with various books, against an orange wall. At the 0:23 mark, a blue graphic with the bold white text "DAILY DOUBLE" appears over the lower part of the man and the aquarium, with "Moby Games" in smaller text below the main title, before disappearing at 0:26, returning the scene to its original view.

In this video segment, a man with glasses and a beard, wearing a greyish-blue collared shirt, is seated in a dark wooden chair and speaking directly to the camera. His facial expression is attentive and he frequently uses hand gestures to emphasize his points, including open palms, precise finger movements, and clasped hands. Behind him is a large, semicircular aquarium filled with lush green aquatic plants, smaller carpeting plants, and several small fish, as well as a larger dark fish near the bottom. The aquarium is set on a dark wooden cabinet. On either side of the man, and slightly behind him, are bookshelves packed with various books, against a reddish-orange wall. The camera remains static throughout the clip, focusing on the man and his aquatic background.

A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a grey short-sleeved collared shirt, sits in a brown wooden chair, looking directly at the camera and speaking. He uses hand gestures, initially pointing with his right hand, then gesturing with both hands, and finally clasping his hands together. Behind him is a large, curved aquarium teeming with lush green aquatic plants and several small fish swimming within. The aquarium is built into a wooden cabinet. To the man's left and right, bookshelves filled with various books, some with reddish-orange spines, line the walls, creating a warm, academic backdrop.

In the video segment, a man wearing glasses, a beard, and a grey collared shirt is seated in front of a large, well-lit fish tank filled with vibrant green aquatic plants and several small fish. He is actively speaking, looking directly at the camera, and gesturing with both hands, particularly his right hand, as he emphasizes points in his speech. Behind him, on either side of the fish tank, are wooden bookshelves filled with books, providing a warm, academic backdrop. The scene remains static throughout this short segment, with no significant visual changes or text displayed.

A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a grey collared shirt, sits in a dark wooden chair, facing and speaking to the camera. He gestures with his hands to emphasize his points. Behind him, a large, curved aquarium is prominently displayed, filled with lush green aquatic plants and several small fish swimming around. The aquarium is integrated into a wooden cabinet. On either side of the aquarium and behind the man, there are bookshelves packed with numerous books. The wall in the background is a warm reddish-orange color.

A man with a light blue polo shirt, a beard, and glasses is seated, talking and gesturing with his right hand. Behind him is a large, curved aquarium filled with vibrant green aquatic plants and several fish swimming. Flanking the aquarium on both sides are tall bookshelves packed with various books, against a reddish-orange wall.

A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a grey collared shirt, sits in front of a large, lush green planted aquarium, with bookshelves flanking it on either side. He speaks directly to the camera, occasionally gesturing with his right hand. Overlaying the bottom half of the screen is a black box containing white bulleted text, which the man appears to be referencing as he speaks. The visible text reads: "• IT IS BIODEGRADABLE IN MARINE ENVIRONMENTS (SEA WATER) & FRESHWATER. • BIODEGRADATION RESULTS IN THE MINERALISATION OF THE COMPOUND TO WATER AND CARBON DIOXIDE. • GLUTARALDEHYDE IS VERY WATER SOLUBLE AND HIGHLY UNLIKELY TO BIO-ACCUMULATE IN THE FATTY TISSUES OF AQUATIC ORGANISMS. • IT IS REMOVED IN WASTE WATER TREATMENT PLANTS BY MORE THAN 95% BY BIODEGRADATION AND OTHER DEGRADATION PROCESSES. • IT DOES NOT INHIBIT REPRODUCTIVE SUCCESS IN FISH OR CRUSTACEA. • IT IS DEGRADED IN THE ATMOSPHERE BY REACTION WITH UV LIGHT AND OXIDATION BY HYDROXYL RADICALS." (This text lists properties of glutaraldehyde, including its biodegradability, its breakdown into water and carbon dioxide, its low bio-accumulation potential, its removal in wastewater treatment, its non-inhibition of reproductive success in aquatic life, and its degradation by UV light and hydroxyl radicals.)

A man with a light brown beard and clear-rimmed glasses, wearing a grey short-sleeved collared shirt, sits facing the camera and speaks. Below the aquarium is a dark wooden cabinet or stand. Further to the right, another tall wooden bookshelf, also filled with books, completes the background setting. The man maintains eye contact with the camera throughout the segment.

The video segment opens at 00:04 with a man, sporting a beard and glasses, wearing a grey collared shirt, sitting and directly addressing the camera with a slight smile. Behind him, a large, curved glass aquarium, densely filled with various vibrant green aquatic plants and small fish, serves as the backdrop. The aquarium is flanked by dark wood bookshelves packed with books, and the wall behind him is orange. At 00:10, the scene transitions to an end screen with a plain light grey background. A prominent, stylized black, swirling, vine-like design occupies the center of the screen. On the left side, the words "SUBSCRIBE" (with a YouTube logo), "GOOGLE G+" (with a Google+ logo), "INSTAGRAM" (with an Instagram logo and the handle "HTTP://INSTAGRAM.COM/NICKMACHO07"), and "THANKS FOR WATCHING" are displayed in a clean, sans-serif font. The top of the screen features the text "NICKMACHO07PLANTEDTANK" with a black shark silhouette to its right. On the right side, two video thumbnails are shown. The top thumbnail, labeled "PREVIOUS", initially displays a modern building with a large glass triangular roof against a cloudy sky. This "PREVIOUS" thumbnail changes between 00:31 and 00:36 to show a red-striped building with the text "TENNESSEE AQUARIUM RIVER JOURNEY", before reverting to the modern building with the glass roof. The bottom thumbnail, labeled "CHANNEL", consistently shows a lush, green planted aquarium.
